step1 read
step2 select
step3 combine csv with vector（geojson）
step4 select a certain area

```{r}
# packages
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(countrycode)
```
# loading Data
```{r}
# data frame
mycsv <- read_csv("homework4/1990_2023_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv")
mycsv <- read_csv(
  "homework4/1990_2023_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv",
  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
  na = c("", "NA", "NULL", "n/a")
)

Datatypelist <- mycsv %>%
  summarise_all(class) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "All_variables",
    values_to = "Variable_class"
  )
Datatypelist
```
```{r}
# vector
GlobalShape <- st_read("homework4/World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson")

plot(GlobalShape)
```

# munging Data
```{r}
GLOBALGenderInequality_index <- mycsv %>%
  dplyr::select(c(1:2,636:669))
```

```{r}
# Diff = 2019-2010
GLOBALGenderInequality_index <- GLOBALGenderInequality_index %>%
  mutate(Diff10_19 = gii_2019 - gii_2010,
         Diff_agg = (gii_2019 - gii_2010)*100)

gii_Datatypelist <- GLOBALGenderInequality_index %>%
  summarise_all(class) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "All_variables",
    values_to = "Variable_class"
  )
gii_Datatypelist
```

```{r}
# add iso3
GlobalShape <- GlobalShape %>%
  mutate(
    iso3c = countrycode(
      COUNTRY,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "iso3c"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# connect
GlobalShape1 <- GlobalShape %>%
  merge(
    .,
    GLOBALGenderInequality_index,
    by.x = "iso3c",
    by.y = "iso3"
  )

GlobalShape1 <- GlobalShape1 %>%
  select(-c(ISO,COUNTRYAFF,AFF_ISO,country))
```

# test and plot with diff
```{r}
ggplot(GlobalShape1) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = Diff_agg), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    name = "Diff in 2010-2019",
    low = "purple",
    mid = "white",
    high = "green",
    na.value = "grey80"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Global Gender Inequality Index") +
  theme_minimal()
```
